decisions.reason: The front-box visual reference does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The image is a reference for one front-page box and does not necessarily modify the report-wide premium visual style.
A visual reference for the front box does not alter the footer's presentation or page coverage.
The front-box reference does not address or change the internal-page header.
Supplying a visual reference does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset handoff.
The front-box reference does not change the required editable formats, report variants, or PDF-export support.
The image governs front-box appearance, not the mapping between report variants, scores, risk bands, and exposure levels.
The visual reference does not change the requirement for editable, version-consistent report identifiers.
